summary.summary: * The Norwegian Refugee Council (NRC) assesses metrics annually to identify refugees most at risk due to disparities in international community support and funding, highlighting that not all refugees receive equal treatment despite equal inherent worth. [Source](https://www.bostonglobe.com/2023/06/20/opinion/disparity-refugee-funding/?camp=bg:brief:rss:feedly&rss_id=feedly_rss_brief)
